articles.summary: Ventas, Inc. (NYSE: VTR) (“Ventas” or the “Company”) announced today that its wholly owned subsidiary, Ventas Realty, Limited Partnership (“Ventas Realty”), has priced an underwritten public offering of $500.0 million aggregate principal amount of 5.500% Senior Notes due 2033 (the “Notes”) at an issue price equal to 99.441% of the principal amount of the Notes. The Notes will be senior unsecured obligations of Ventas Realty and will be fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the Company and will mature on December 15, 2033. The sale of the Notes is expected to close on November 10, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions. The Company intends to use the proceeds from the offering of the Notes for general corporate purposes, which may include repayment of other indebtedness, or any other general corporate purposes the Company may deem necessary or advisable, and to pay fees and expenses related to the offering of the Notes. J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, BofA
articles.title: Ventas Announces Pricing of Senior Notes Offering
